entries.title: Eternals

violence.summary: Frequent superhero combat includes frightening Deviants, implied civilian deaths, goopy monster gore, weapons, genocide imagery, Hiroshima aftermath, natural disasters, and major-character deaths.

language.summary: Occasional mild-to-moderate profanity, religious exclamations, insults, and a middle-finger gesture appear.

romance.summary: Romance is more prominent than usual for MCU entries, including passionate kissing, bare shoulders/backs in an implied sex scene, crushes, embraces, and affectionate married-couple moments.

drinking.summary: Adults drink beer, liquor, mead, ale, and homemade alcohol; one post-credit character appears drunk and drunkenness is joked about.

handoffNotes: Large-scale loss and grief are central and may need prose beyond the scored violence flag.
